dishes.name: Tepsi kebabı
dishes.desc: Minced lamb and beef baked in a tray in a wood-fired oven with tomatoes and peppers. A true Antakya dish, locally called lahm-ı sini.

dishes.name: Oruk
dishes.desc: Hatay's version of içli köfte with a bulgur shell and a filling of minced and pounded meat. The tray-baked sini oruğu is especially popular.

dishes.name: Künefe
dishes.desc: Warm shredded pastry with melted cheese under syrup. Antakya künefe shops are famous for their own recipes.

dishes.name: Humus
dishes.desc: Chickpea paste with tahini and lemon, served warm and often for breakfast. Antakya's meze culture makes it a daily staple.

dishes.name: Biberli ekmek
dishes.desc: Flatbread filled with red pepper paste, onion and walnuts or spices. A popular Antakya street bread.
